rules: A rerun MUST NOT erase a previous failure. Every attempt is preserved (closure-evidence/v2/P1-RUN-HISTORY.json, append-only).
A retry may satisfy a gate only when the first outcome is deterministically classified as a preregistered retryable class and this policy permits it.
For every other class a rerun is diagnostic only. A later green attempt does not convert the original failure into an environmental flake.
A classification must cite its evidence (a log signature, an exit reason); a class chosen because a rerun passed is not a classification.
